deadline.value: Mines' deadlines page gives a Fall international PhD date of March 1 but no year, so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: The catalog gives no subject GRE rule for this PhD.

supervisor.value: No official text on this PhD says whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page says assistantships are generally awarded, which does not show that most students are funded.

entry_route.value: The PhD can be designed for applicants with a master's or with a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A course of study leading to the PhD degree can be designed either for the student who has completed the master's degree or for the student who has completed the bachelor's degree.

toefl_min.value: The Computer Science department requires a TOEFL score of 79 or higher for applicants whose native language is not English.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score of 79 or higher (or 550 for the paper-based test or 213 for the computer-based test) for applicants whose native language is not English.

ielts_min.value: The Computer Science department accepts an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 or higher in place of TOEFL.
ielts_min.quote: In lieu of a TOEFL score, and IELTS score of 6.5 or higher will be accepted.

notes: The PhD requires 72 credits of coursework and research credits.
